Pod Juice Cotton Clouds Nixodine Vape Juice INTRODUCTION

Pod Juice Cotton Clouds Nixodine E-juice replaces nicotine with nixodine and brings you 30ml vape juice of the classic cotton clouds flavors. If you enjoy sweet and mellow cotton candy flavor, you should not miss Pod Juice Cotton Clouds E-juice. It comes with a 30ml bottle and only contains nicotine, a substance (analog) that is claimed to have similar effects to nicotine. You can still fill your pod kit with the Pod Juice Cotton Clouds Nixodine E-juice and feel the sugary cotton candy flavors with the sensation brought by nixodine.

Features

• This product contains Nixodine. Nixodine is a nicotine alternative (nicotine analog) that allegedly gives a similar user experience to traditional nicotine vapes.

• E-juice Capacity: 30ml

• Nicotine Alternative: Nixodine

• Bottle Type: Chubby Gorilla

• Made in the USA

• Nixodine Levels: 35mg / 55mg

• VG/PG: Unknown

item.title: RAZ Vue 70K Disposable Vape Kit 5% (70000 Puffs)
item.description:
RAZ Vue 70K Disposable Vape Kit

RAZ Vue 70K Vape INTRODUCTION

RAZ Vue 70K Disposable Vape Full Kit is equipped with a pre-filled 16ml pod and a rechargeable power bank. As the upgraded version of the RAZ Vue 50K, Vue 70K comes with 2ml extra e-liquid for around 20K puffs. The RAZ Vue pod can be used independently but requires the power bank for recharging. The LED digital screen in the power bank shows you the vaping mode and battery life, and there are two RGB indicators at the bottom of the RAZ Vue Pod showing pod battery status separately.

Features

• First Disposable Vape with Detachable Battery by RAZ

• Transparent and Replaceable Pod with 16ml Pre-filled E-juice

• Rechargeable Battery Built into the Pod

• Reusable Power Bank

• Puff Count: Approximately 70000 Puffs

• LED Display Screen with Power Status, Battery Indicator and Vaping Animation

• Leakproof Bottom Airflow

• 5% (50mg/ml) Nicotine Strength

• USB Type-C Charging (Cable Not Included)

• Draw-Activated

• MTL Vaping
